properties.name: The owner can rule a prediction refuted by a named result, and it reads refuted by that ruling
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-28, gap 1 of the design-a-phenomenon skill (#807)
properties.statement: When an experiment's result contradicts a prediction, the owner can record a signed ruling that the prediction (and the hypothesis discharged into it) is refuted by that result. Until the ruling, the result only contests. After it, the claim reads refuted by the owner's ruling on the named result, conditional on the held model and the idealizations it rests on, and the read-back (reasoning_report, propagate_from, loop_status) names the ruling, the result and those conditions. The ruling is the owner's own (signed, refused for anyone else), can be withdrawn, and changes no other design's reading.
